creative_ideation.scope: Cross-domain association, de-novo concept or mechanism invention, creative writing, narrative dialogue, and open-ended brainstorming.

architecture_reasoning.scope: First-principles system architecture, formal or mathematical reasoning, trade-off critique, and multi-system design planning without modifying source code.

code_implementation.scope: Write, fix, refactor, or test backend, CLI, library, algorithm, configuration, or quantitative/experiment code.

frontend_ui.scope: Implement, refactor, or style user-facing web or desktop UI views, interactive components, charts, layouts, CSS, and animations.

code_audit.scope: Independent read-only review or audit of code, pull requests, diffs, branches, security invariants, or release readiness (including writing a review report file).

exploration_forensics.scope: Read-only codebase exploration, log/database/metric forensics, and runtime root-cause diagnosis on local evidence without modifying code.

web_research.scope: Gather, verify, and synthesize information from the public web, literature, documentation, or vendor sources into a sourced report.

visual_analysis.scope: Static offline inspection of images, photos, screenshots, or design mockups: OCR, UI layout/mockup diffs, and fine-grained aesthetic, styling, material, or lighting classification.

text_processing.scope: Rule-defined structured text cleaning, translation, format conversion, mechanical extraction, and bounded summarization.

live_loop.scope: Low-latency observe-decide-act loop attached to a live external text, WebSocket, or API stream where per-turn response time affects the outcome.

gui_control.scope: Operate a live desktop, browser, or mobile graphical interface via screenshots, mouse clicks, and keyboard actions, or continuously monitor a live visual screen.

other_or_mixed.scope: Unprofiled fallback route when no canonical work_kind was supplied.
